priorStories.headline: Strike on vessel in Hormuz kills one
priorStories.body:
A projectile struck a commercial vessel traveling through the Strait of Hormuz, starting a fire and forcing the crew to evacuate, according to the British navy-linked UK Maritime Trade Operations agency.

Iranian authorities said one person was killed and four crew members were wounded aboard the Iranian vessel, which was struck off Iran’s coast. Responsibility for the attack had not been established.

candidates.summary: Yemen’s Houthi rebels captured the Greater and Lesser Hanish islands in the southern Red Sea after government-allied forces withdrew, according to two Yemeni government officials and a Houthi official. The islands are about 160 kilometers north of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a major shipping route.
candidates.title: Houthis capture two strategic Red Sea islands

candidates.summary: Nigerian industrialist Aliko Dangote opened Africa’s largest oil refinery to public ownership through an initial public offering seeking $1.6 billion from retail investors. Shares were offered at 5,250 naira each, with Dangote retaining an 87% stake.
candidates.title: Dangote opens refinery to public investors

candidates.summary: China’s Foreign Ministry rejected Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei’s call for continued U.S. restrictions on sales of advanced artificial-intelligence chips and manufacturing equipment to China. Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said confrontation and competition would disrupt global AI governance.
candidates.title: China responds to Anthropic chief’s AI restrictions proposal

candidates.summary: Greek authorities said 51 people were rescued after a boat carrying migrants from Libya took on water south of Crete early Monday. At least one person died, and 20 others were believed missing as coast guard vessels, aircraft, commercial ships and the EU border agency Frontex continued searching.
candidates.title: One dead and 20 missing from migrant boat near Crete

candidates.summary: NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte pledged increased support for Ukraine and stronger defenses along the alliance’s eastern border after Russian drone strikes near Poland. Polish officials also said the military recovered what was believed to be a Russian drone from the Baltic Sea near Jaroslawiec.
candidates.title: NATO chief pledges more Ukraine support after border-area strikes

candidates.summary: Finland joined France’s Forward Nuclear Deterrence Initiative, Finnish and French leaders said. The initiative provides for consultations, exercises and possible temporary deployments of nuclear-capable assets, while leaving decisions on the use of France’s nuclear weapons with the French president. Finland said it did not intend to station nuclear weapons on its territory in peacetime.
candidates.title: Finland joins French nuclear deterrence initiative

candidates.summary: The World Food Programme’s acting executive director said funding for its Sudan operations had fallen from $645 million last year to $206 million so far this year, leaving a gap of nearly $300 million to sustain current operations. The International Organization for Migration separately warned that emergency supplies for displaced people could run out by the end of September without additional funding.
candidates.title: UN agencies warn of worsening Sudan aid shortfalls

candidates.summary: Two regional officials briefed on repairs said Saudi Arabia’s East-West Pipeline would remain mostly out of service for three to five weeks after an attack the previous week damaged the line and a major pumping facility. One official said limited oil movements might continue while repairs were underway.
candidates.title: Damaged Saudi oil pipeline expected to face weeks of repairs

candidates.summary: President Donald Trump dismissed calls for new artificial-intelligence guardrails, describing opposition to rapid AI and data-center development as a conspiracy. He said the United States should maintain its lead over China, while acknowledging that some regulation was needed without offering specific proposals.
candidates.title: Trump dismisses calls for new AI guardrails
